nodes.description: Address of the contract creator; set from msg.sender and used as the only authorization for kill().
Counter incremented on every payable deposit; read by getNumberOfDeposits().
Timestamp (now + 5 minutes at construction) gating the selfdestruct in kill().
Constructor: writes creator from msg.sender, zeroes deposits and sets unlockTime from block.timestamp.
Payable fallback function that forwards all plain value transfers to deposit().
Payable deposit function; increments deposits when msg.value > 0 and returns the new count.
Constant getter returning the deposits counter.
Constant getter returning the unlockTime timestamp.
Privileged function that destroys the contract when msg.sender == creator and now >= unlockTime.
Caller-controlled address used to set creator and to authorize selfdestruct.
Miner-influenced block timestamp (now) used to set and later check unlockTime.
selfdestruct(creator) inside kill(); irreversible destruction of the contract.
Unsigned arithmetic 'deposits = deposits + 1' susceptible to overflow in the 0.4.x compiler.
Call-supplied msg.value used inside deposit() as the guard for incrementing deposits.

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored into creator inside the constructor, tainting the owner state variable.
Constructor writes the creator state variable.
Block timestamp (now + 5 minutes) is written into unlockTime, creating a timestamp dependency.
Constructor assigns unlockTime from the time-dependent expression.
The payable fallback invokes deposit() to process incoming value.
msg.value flows into deposit() and controls the deposit branch.
deposit() performs the unsigned addition deposits + 1.
Result of the unchecked addition is stored back into the deposits state variable.
deposit() calls getNumberOfDeposits() for its return value.
getNumberOfDeposits() reads the deposits state variable.
getUnlockTime() reads the unlockTime state variable.
kill() reads creator to compare it against the caller for authorization.
msg.sender gates the kill() branch; a wrong authorization check would allow unauthorized destruction.
now >= unlockTime gates kill(); miner-manipulable timestamp controls the privileged path.
kill() executes the selfdestruct unsafe operation once the guard passes.
selfdestruct forwards the contract balance to the creator address.

normalization_plan.reason: msg.value is a transient, per-call non-core value that is only used inside deposit() to gate the deposits increment, so it is normalized into the deposit() function node.
